# @three-ws/avatar-agent

> 3D AI Agent Avatar — MCP server that spawns a textured GLB avatar, inspects/validates/optimizes any 3D model, gives the agent a Solana wallet + a voice, and ships full pump.fun powers (atomic Jito-bundled launches + creator-fee collection). Powered by three.ws.

@three-ws/avatar-agent is a Model Context Protocol server from three.ws. Install: `npx -y @three-ws/avatar-agent`.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/nirholas/avatar-agent-mcp/blob/main/README.md): install, configuration, full reference
- [Documentation site](https://nirholas.github.io/avatar-agent-mcp/): the README as a web page
- [Full text for LLMs](https://nirholas.github.io/avatar-agent-mcp/llms-full.txt): README inlined
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/nirholas/avatar-agent-mcp/blob/main/AGENTS.md): guidance for coding agents
